correctness.rationale: The relation alpha beta=beta alpha=empty is equivalent to R_alpha disjoint D_beta and D_alpha disjoint R_beta. Compress through the full-column-rank domain/image incidence P; P^T P has positive diagonal r!, so Sylvester inertia reduces to K. Its rank blocks vanish above a+b=n, and each a+b=n block is complement/swap permutation; deform lower rank blocks continuously to zero without changing determinant or inertia. The endpoint involution has binom(n,n/2) fixed points for even n, none for odd n; this proves all signs, rank/nullity and spectral product for every n. Verified finite n=1..4 and independent direct compositions n<=3; finite tests are corroboration only. The inclusion of the empty map and diagonal loops is essential.
